footprints.scope: Closed building ways and multipolygon buildings; building:part excluded

method.confidence: support_score = significant-plane coverage (clamped 0–1) times accepted planar-point share; uncalibrated support indicator, not probability
method.limitations: Acquisition dates are source metadata; current roof validation absent; unclassified returns may contain vegetation. Nulls are not flat roofs. Other is classifier complex. All quality grades D.
method.parameterSource: Existing lidar pilot params.json / roofplanes.classify_roof v1
method.pitch: Area-weighted plane inclination in degrees from horizontal
method.ridge: Approximate principal-footprint-axis bearing inferred from facing roof planes, clockwise from true north, modulo 180; not a traced ridge segment

source.originalVerticalUnits: US survey foot (source bounds conversion verified)
source.title: USGS 3DEP SC_SavannahPeeDee_2019_B19 (delivery SC_SavannahPeeDee_2_2019)
source.verticalEvidenceNote: Original LAS header min/max Z multiplied by 1200/3937 match the EPT source bounds to <1e-6 m. EPT Z is already metres; no conversion applied. This checks units, not absolute vertical accuracy.
